title: MONSTER Autopilot
tagline: Flight control computing! Stabilize robotic wings and vehicles using 6-axis gyroscope accelerometer fusion.

phases.instructions: Collect the MPU-6050 6-DOF IMU sensor module, SG90 servo motor, tactile momentary button, 1602 LCD, and breadboard.
verificationCheckpoints: MPU-6050 sensor board with onboard 3.3V regulator ready
SG90 servo motor with gimbal horn ready

phases.instructions: Connect MPU-6050 to 5V, GND, SDA (A4), SCL (A5), and INT to Pin 2. Connect Servo to Pin 9, and LCD to shared I2C bus.
verificationCheckpoints: MPU-6050 and LCD sharing I2C bus cleanly
Servo mounted to gimbal pivot bracket

phases.instructions: Keep the IMU completely flat and motionless on your desk during initial power-on calibration.
verificationCheckpoints: Board resting flat on level surface
Wires relaxed without pulling on IMU board

phases.instructions: Review how the sketch fuses accelerometer gravity vectors with gyro angular rate integration to compute a drift-free tilt angle.
phases.codeExplanation:
- 0x6B register write wakes the MPU-6050 from sleep mode.
- High and low bytes are combined (Wire.read() << 8 | Wire.read()) to form signed 16-bit acceleration values.
- atan2(ay, az) calculates exact physical pitch angle from Earth's gravity vector.
- Servo moves opposite to tilt angle (90 - angle), keeping platform level.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand how gravity vector reveals tilt angle
Understand negative feedback loop in gimbal stabilization

phases.instructions: Upload sketch. Pick up the breadboard and tilt it left and right: notice how the servo platform instantly tilts in reverse to stay horizontal!
verificationCheckpoints: Platform counters roll and pitch tilts
Platform remains horizontal during gentle motion

phases.instructions: Autopilot online! You engineered an active closed-loop inertial stabilization flight controller.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Autopilot Ace badge

story: Build an Autonomous Flight Control & Gimbal Autopilot! Read real-time pitch, roll, and angular acceleration from an MPU-6050 6-axis gyroscope/accelerometer over I2C, and actively counter external tilts using micro-servos to keep a camera platform perfectly level in mid-air.

troubleshooting.cause: MPU-6050 didn't wake up or I2C address is 0x69 (if AD0 pin is high)
troubleshooting.solution: Verify AD0 pin is tied to GND (sets address to 0x68) and ensure 0x6B wake-up command is sent in setup.
diagnosticSteps: Write 0x00 to power management register 0x6B to wake from sleep.
Verify SDA on A4 and SCL on A5.
